title: PaymentLink
description: A shareable link that allows customers to make payments via card or bank account without requiring custom frontend development.

paymentLinkCode.description: Unique code identifier used in the payment link URL.

accountID.description: The Moov account that created this payment link.

status.description: Current usability status of the payment link.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code for the payment.

description.description: Description of what the payment is for.

url.description: The shareable URL for this payment link.

expiresOn.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the payment link expires.

createdOn.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the payment link was created.

updatedOn.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the payment link was last updated.
